why: The Founding Our Future Expo is the empty Militech exposition hall in Dogtown's Golden Pacific, later used by BARGHEST as a depot whose centrepiece is a Militech Chimera under covering. In vanilla the hall's questdesign section is instantiated only by q302_02_spider, so in the clean slate the hall is sealed, unlit and unpopulated. This proposal re-declares #q302_pr_spidertank, switches on the hall's maintenance drones and a small BARGHEST guard detail, restores the stored Chimera in its standby state, and flips the two variant states that vanilla leaves in their post-story form (cracked shaft floor, hidden expo lighting).

open_questions: Both communities have posture unknown: no community-area node or workspot map exists in any converted sector for #302_spidertank_drones or #q302_com_sec1_before_activ, so phase a cannot be proven relaxed. Tour: do the four guards idle at posts, and do the six patrol drones hover calmly rather than take up combat poses?
Does #chimera militech_chimera/q302_standby give the covered, dormant unit the wiki shows, or a live boss that wakes on approach? If it wakes, drop the spawn set.

Is the hall reachable from Dogtown at all? The route devices that matter (mall door #q302_dvc_mall_door_2, parking lift #q301_dvc_lift_expo_parking, arena shutter #q302_dvc_spider_arena_shutter) have no resolved $/ paths in the catalogue, so DoorScope cannot drive them. The tour must find and check the real entrance.
q302_hide_after_expo=0 comes from vanilla's q301_fail cleanup; confirm it gives lit, walkable expo lighting in the clean slate rather than a stage-only glow.
Are the four chosen guard spots inside the spidertank hall or in the expo corridor? Without a spot map the positions are inferred from the record names.

communities.why: The hall's own maintenance crew: six q302_spidertank_drone patrol units and two q302_repairing_drone units, the people who keep a stored Chimera serviceable. Vanilla only switches the whole community on for the bossfight; its registry starts every entry in phase a, so activating it whole gives the depot's ambient drone presence without any quest wiring.

BARGHEST rifleman on the depot floor. The spawner is named 'before_activ' and phase a is the set vanilla places before the bossfight switches the waves on, so it should read as a pre-combat guard post rather than a firefight; posture has to be checked on tour because the community has no spot map.
BARGHEST heavy gunner holding the hall entrance. Same pre-activation phase a as the other guards; the HMG record is the depot's anchor guard.
BARGHEST sniper on the arena balcony, watching the stored Chimera from above. Phase a again; the balcony posts are exactly where a depot watch would stand.
Second BARGHEST rifleman so the depot reads as a guarded shift rather than a single sentry. Phase a keeps him on the pre-fight posting.

spawn_sets.why: The reason the venue is called the spidertank arena: BARGHEST stores a Militech Chimera in the expo hall under covering. q302_standby is the dormant state vanilla sets long before the arena fight, so the unit sits inert in the hall instead of running the boss encounter.

variant_toggles.why: The streaming block authors the shaft with var_crackedfloor=1 (the post-fight cracked look) and q302.questphase resets it to 0 before the story starts. We want that pre-story intact floor, otherwise the arena entrance shows the boss-fight damage.

The location prefab defaults to q302_hide_after_expo=1, i.e. the post-expo lighting where the hall's presentation lights are hidden. Vanilla's own q301_fail cleanup sets it to 0; with 0 the hall keeps its expo lighting and is walkable rather than a dark shell.

proximity_wait.why: DoorControllerPS in the venue's gameplay/devices prefab, on the normal way from the expo into the main spidertank hall: vanilla q302_02_spider unpowers it as V and Myers walk through. A device, not a workspot, and the nearest resolved device to the people we place.
